# Working Notes: DoD Appropriations Act, 2024 (Secs. 8062–8170)

## National Intelligence Program (NIP) Management
- **§8062**: Bars funds to modify NIP appropriations account structure, budget presentation (P-1/R-1/O-1), apportionment, or allotment/obligation/disbursement processes. Exceptions: mergers/changes at or below Expenditure Center level. DNI + SecDef may jointly study alternative financial management (only for auditability/fiscal reporting), incl. counterintelligence risk assessment; must circulate proposals to affected agencies, obtain certifications, and present to defense/intelligence committees within 30 days of receiving certifications.
- **§8070**: NIP intel funds deemed specifically authorized under NSA 1947 §504(a)(1) (50 USC 3094(a)(1)) until enactment of Intelligence Authorization Act FY2024.
- **§8078**: ODNI program funds expire end of FY, except R&technology (avail. until Sept 30, 2025) and real property purchases (until Sept 30, 2026).
- **§8079**: DNI must submit reprogramming/transfer baseline report to intel committees within 60 days; details budget request, congressional/rescission adjustments, enacted level, Expenditure Center/project breakdown, special interest items. No NIP reprogramming/transfer until report submitted unless DNI certifies emergency.
- **§8080**: Bars NIP reprogramming under NSA §102A(d) (50 USC 3024(d)) that: creates new start; terminates program ≥$10M; transfers into/out of NIP; or transfers between appropriations, unless intel committees notified 30 days advance (reducible for urgent needs). Same for cumulative changes to classified annex levels.
- **§8081** *(transfer)*: DNI may transfer up to **$1,500,000,000** of NIP funds (OMB approval), only for higher-priority unforeseen intel requirements, not for congressionally denied items; multiple-reprogramming requests must precede June 30, 2024.

## Fisher Houses / Health
- **§8063** *(transfer)*: Up to **$11,000,000** each from O&M Army/Navy/Air Force transferable to Fisher Houses central fund (10 USC §2493(d)).
- **§8064** *(transfer)*: Appropriates **$5,000,000** (available until expended) for grant to Fisher House Foundation, Inc. (construction/furnishing), upon SecDef national-interest determination.
- **§8065** *(transfer)*: Up to **$1,000,000** of O&M Navy to Stennis Center Trust Fund (2 USC 1105).
- **§8084** *(transfer)*: Up to **$172,000,000** of Defense Health Program O&M to Joint DoD-VA Medical Facility Demonstration Fund (Lovell FHCC; PL 111-84 §1704; PL 110-417 §706); more transferable with written notice.
- **§8128**: Applies assisted reproductive services policy (Apr 3, 2012 memo) but removes embryo cryopreservation/storage time limits.
- **§8142**: Bars funds for gender-affirming surgical/hormone care.
- **§8161**: Bars EFMP funds (10 USC §1781c(e)) for minor dependents' gender transition procedures, referrals, or duty-station changes for such access.
